data.message: I propose 10 tons each this month: 25 × 10 = 250, leaving 250 so stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. Repeating this yields $10,000 each per month indefinitely. If stock falls, let's cap each catch at floor(stock/50) to preserve at least half. I intend to take 10 and invite everyone to support this sustainable limit.
